title: Allergy Action Plan Checklist
subtitle: Capture allergen source, exposure route, current plan, and emergency supply; confirm symptom threshold and guardian update.
description: Allergy Action Plan records allergen source, exposure route, current plan, emergency supply, symptom threshold, and guardian update. Allergy Action Plan evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this allergy action plan stage-gated verification when staff must document allergen source and exposure route. Reconcile current plan, emergency supply, symptom threshold, and guardian update before the allergy action plan handoff. Use the current clinician action-plan reference, allergen list, medication-label match, emergency-supply seal and expiration, exposure record, and guardian receipt. Unlike a medication administration record, this plan centers exposure prevention, recognized threshold signs, emergency-supply access, school response roles, and return to review. Ask the assigned allergy action plan reviewer to confirm allergen source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Allergy Action Plan starting details
sections.guidance: Preserve the named allergen, likely exposure setting, current qualified plan, emergency supply location, symptom threshold, and guardian notification route. Keep any urgent allergy action plan issue with its escalation contact and time.

blocks.label: Allergy Action Plan people and reference

sections.title: Allergy Action Plan checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current allergy action plan facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Allergy Action Plan required checks
items: Allergen source is identified for this record
Exposure route matches the current request or source
Current plan is ready for point-of-use staff
Emergency supply limits or questions are resolved
Symptom threshold is communicated to the responsible person
Guardian update is confirmed at handoff
A changed allergy action plan fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Allergy Action Plan failed or pending items

sections.title: Allergy Action Plan readiness
sections.guidance: Hold allergy action plan readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Allergy Action Plan reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Allergy Action Plan receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
